segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Morning, Maya. We’ve got about a half hour. I wanted to confirm pricing for 84 seats and what it takes to start May 6.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, perfect. I’ve got 25 minutes before I’m back in the CRM updating pipeline notes from yesterday, so let’s make this useful. For 84 seats, annual is $58,800, billed upfront, with implementation at $7,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The seat count may land at 90 if support gets added, but finance asked me to price the 84 first. Is the implementation fee fixed?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For your scope, yes. Two admin workshops, one data import, and go-live support the first week. If you move to 90 seats, subscription goes to $63,000 even, implementation stays the same.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s within the range. We need net 45 on the invoice, though. Our standard vendor terms are not net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 45 is doable on a 12-month term if legal doesn’t change indemnity. And sorry I didn’t get this back to you before close yesterday, I had a two-hour block cleaning duplicate account entries in the database and it squeezed my call time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. On legal, I don’t think we’ll touch indemnity. The only redline may be auto-renewal notice. We need 60 days, not 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s pretty standard. I can put 60-day non-renewal notice in the order form. For a May 6 go-live, we’d want signature by April 19 so the kickoff can be April 23.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: April 19 is realistic if you can get us the paper this afternoon. I’ve got our VP reviewing tomorrow at 10.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can send it by 3 if deal desk turns the approval. I’ve got to assemble the internal discount packet first, which cuts into the buyer calls I had lined up, but this one is straightforward.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Dana in procurement. If the total is $66,300 with services, that’s what I’ll route.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, $58,800 subscription plus $7,500 implementation, total $66,300, net 45, 60-day notice, 84 seats. I’ll get it over today.
